faithful_paraphrase: The button becomes available on turn 3, costs 3 Gold, can be used once per turn and three times per game, and its offers improve on later turns.
Offered Tavern Tiers rise by turn, and from turn 6 one offer is guaranteed to match the player's most common minion type; this creates real value in waiting but does not prescribe one optimal turn.
Patch 36.2.2 changed numerous gift effects, turn windows, and restrictions, so advice created before 2026-08-18 may rely on a materially different gift distribution.
Replies repeatedly frame the first Gift as an alternative use of 3 Gold when the shop is weak; suggested first-use timing clusters around turns 5-6 but varies with health, tribes, hero, and curve.
Players report pressing early on a bad shop, sometimes using one early charge and saving later charges; other replies favor turn 5, showing no single consensus turn.
A common position is to take one early Gift for tempo around turns 4-5 while preserving later uses, but exact timing is conditional rather than universal.
The discussion again supports one early tempo use with later charges saved for higher-tier outcomes, while emphasizing shop and curve flexibility.
